text:
Sophie: heads-up — gaia-15b-mini canary (canary-v2) is showing a reproducible repetition pattern on long-context summarization (>2k tokens). also seeing truncated URL tokens in a few outputs. noticed after the quant+tokenizer change rolled yesterday.
Jason: repro'd locally with the long_summaries prompt set. quick curl to reproduce: ```curl -X POST https://canary.api.redwood.ai/generate -d '{"model":"gaia-15b-mini","prompt":"<LONG_SUMMARY_PROMPT>","max_tokens":800}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'``` got same repeated clause every ~120 tokens.
Rachel: assigning to me. I'll check kv-cache offsets and tokenizer merges from the last diff. hypothesis: tokenizer merge changed boundary lengths -> shifts in KV alignment when continuous batching used.
deploy-bot: canary rollout canary-v2 completed 2026-02-28T14:12:03Z (traffic 5%).
Sophie: can we pause traffic to canary-v1 until we triage? this looks like a P1 regression for summarization customers.
Tom: paused canary traffic and pinned to canary-v1. Running eval-suite long_summaries and url_preserve against canary-v2 at 1000 samples to quantify.
Rachel: early findings — when seq_len > 2048 the runtime fell back to a legacy attention kernel that has an off-by-one in KV index math. log snippet: ```ERROR: kv_cache_mismatch: expected_offset=12845 actual_offset=12844 at layer 9``` explains the repeated fragment. tokenizer changes exacerbate since token boundaries shifted and the mismatch propagates.
Jason: nice catch. are we sure it's kernel selection and not quant rounding? the reproducer with FP16 still shows the issue.
Rachel: confirmed — FP16 + fp32 both reproduce; quantization not root cause. kernel fallback path has the bug.
Sophie: plan: (1) block canary-v2 rollouts, (2) add failing prompts to regression harness, (3) hotfix kernel off-by-one + unit test, (4) re-run eval-suite and only re-roll when pass. P1.
Tom: created ticket INF-3221, linking logs and repro. I'll also run a quick A/B with canary-v2 but forced kernel override to skip legacy path.
Jason: adding a short repro prompt to eval repo: tests/long_summaries/gaia15b_repro.txt
Rachel: will start the hotfix now, ETA ~3h for patch + CI. if we need a rollback to fully stable we can keep pinned.
Sophie: thanks all. please ping here when the patch lands and when the evals show fix. :thumbsup:
